items.label: ✔ Immersive 3
items.value: 2 Productivity Display: Featuring a 13-inch 2K IPS touchscreen (2160x1440 resolution) with a 3:2 aspect ratio, this tablet displays 18% more vertical content than traditional 16:9 screens. Ideal for office tasks, web browsing, and multitasking, the crisp visuals and responsive touch ensure seamless interaction for work or entertainment.

items.label: ✔ N100 Quad-Core Efficiency
items.value: Powered by the energy-efficient N100 processor (up to 3.4GHz), this device delivers smooth performance for daily productivity, video streaming, and light creative work. The quad-core architecture balances power and battery life for all-day usability.

items.label: ✔ Lightning-Fast Multitasking & Storage
items.value: Equipped with 12GB LPDDR5 RAM (4800MT/s) for lag-free multitasking and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD (2000MB/s read/write speeds), experience rapid app launches, quick file transfers, and ample space for documents, media, and software.

items.label: ✔ Versatile Connectivity Options
items.value: Stay connected with dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4G/5G), Bluetooth 5.0, and multiple ports: 1x Full-Featured USB-C (supports charging/data/display), 1x USB-C 2.0, 2x USB 3.2 Gen1 (5Gbps), and a 3.5mm audio jack. Effortlessly connect peripherals, external displays, or high-speed storage devices for enhanced workflow flexibility.
